title: Close remaining Vietnamese provider-label gaps
context: The localization audit found one English key missing from the Vietnamese catalog and the API Key label still uses English text, leaving provider settings visibly mixed-language when Vietnamese is selected.
goal: Translate the remaining Provider and API Key labels into Vietnamese without changing provider configuration or runtime behavior.
forbidden_changes: Do not change English localization values.
Do not rename localization keys used by SwiftUI.
Do not change provider execution, credentials, or settings behavior.
acceptance_criteria: The Vietnamese catalog defines a Provider translation.
The Vietnamese API Key label reads Khóa API.
No other localization values or runtime behavior change.
verification: Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA workflow
Compare localization key/value diff against main
recovery: Revert the single task commit if localization lookup or Apple build regresses.
